principle.name: Mobile-First Responsive Design
principle.description: Always start design and implementation from mobile viewport, then progressively enhance for larger screens
principle.rationale: Ensures optimal performance and user experience on all devices, forces prioritization of essential content

implementation.rule: Use Tailwind's responsive prefixes (sm:, md:, lg:, xl:, 2xl:) to add styles for larger screens
Design layouts that work without any responsive prefixes first
Test on real devices, not just browser dev tools

principle.name: Accessibility-First Design
principle.description: Design and implement with accessibility as a core requirement, not an afterthought
principle.rationale: Ensures inclusive design that works for users with disabilities, improves overall usability for everyone

implementation.rule: Maintain minimum 4.5:1 color contrast ratio for normal text (3:1 for large text)
Ensure all interactive elements are keyboard accessible
Use semantic HTML elements and ARIA attributes appropriately
Provide alternative text for images and icons
Design with sufficient touch target sizes (minimum 44px x 44px)

principle.name: Design Token Consistency
principle.description: Use centralized design tokens for all styling decisions to maintain visual consistency
principle.rationale: Enables easy theme changes, ensures consistency, reduces CSS bloat, improves maintainability

implementation.rule: Define all colors, spacing, typography, and shadows in Tailwind config
Never use arbitrary values like 'p-[23px]' in production
Create custom utility classes for common patterns
Use CSS custom properties for dynamic values

principle.name: Performance-Conscious Styling
principle.description: Optimize CSS delivery and minimize impact on page performance
principle.rationale: Faster page loads improve user experience and SEO rankings

implementation.rule: Purge unused CSS in production builds
Use Tailwind's JIT mode for optimal build sizes
Avoid complex CSS animations on low-end devices
Optimize font loading with proper font-display strategies

practice.rule: Extend the default theme, don't replace it entirely
practice.rationale: Maintains access to Tailwind's well-tested default values while adding custom ones

practice.rule: Use semantic color names for brand-specific colors
practice.rationale: Makes code more maintainable and allows for easy theme changes

example.good: primary, secondary, accent, success, warning, error

practice.rule: Configure proper font loading and optimization

implementation.step: Use next/font for optimal font loading
Configure font-display: swap for custom fonts
Include font fallbacks in the font stack

practice.rule: Create component variants using CSS-in-JS or Tailwind utilities
practice.rationale: Maintains consistency while allowing for flexible component APIs

practice.rule: Use consistent spacing patterns throughout the application

implementation.step: Stick to Tailwind's default spacing scale (4px base unit)
Use consistent padding and margin patterns
Establish container max-widths and consistent grid systems

practice.rule: Group related utility classes logically in className strings
Use container queries when appropriate for component-based responsive design
practice.rationale: Allows components to respond to their container size rather than viewport size

practice.rule: Establish clear breakpoint strategy based on content, not device sizes

implementation.step: sm: 640px - Small tablets and large phones
md: 768px - Tablets
lg: 1024px - Small desktops
xl: 1280px - Large desktops
2xl: 1536px - Extra large screens

guideline.rule: Use tools like WebAIM Contrast Checker to verify color combinations
Don't rely on color alone to convey information
Provide alternative indicators (icons, text, patterns) alongside color

implementation.tool: Use contrast checking tools during design phase
Include success/error states with icons and text

guideline.rule: Ensure all interactive elements are keyboard accessible
Provide visible focus indicators for all focusable elements

implementation.pattern: Use Tailwind's focus: utilities for consistent focus styles
Test navigation using only keyboard (Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space, Arrow keys)
Implement skip links for main content areas

guideline.rule: Provide meaningful alt text for images
Use ARIA labels and descriptions when needed

implementation.pattern: Use heading hierarchy (h1, h2, h3) for content structure
Label form inputs clearly and associate with labels
Provide context for dynamic content changes

optimization.technique: Configure Tailwind purging to remove unused styles

implementation.step: Use content patterns to include all template files
Whitelist dynamic class names that might be purged incorrectly
Monitor bundle size with tools like bundlephobia

optimization.technique: Use CSS custom properties for dynamic theming

benefits.benefit: Reduces bundle size compared to multiple CSS files

implementation.step: Use font-display: swap for custom fonts
Preload critical fonts
Include proper font fallbacks

optimization.technique: Minimize layout shifts with consistent sizing

implementation.step: Use aspect-ratio utilities for media
Define minimum heights for dynamic content areas
Reserve space for loading states

pitfall.description: Using arbitrary values everywhere instead of design tokens
pitfall.why_problematic: Creates inconsistency, makes maintenance difficult, bloats CSS bundle
pitfall.correct_approach: Define values in Tailwind config, use consistent spacing/color scale

pitfall.description: Not testing on real devices and browsers
pitfall.why_problematic: Browser dev tools don't accurately represent real device performance and behavior
pitfall.correct_approach: Test on actual mobile devices, older browsers, and with slow network connections

pitfall.description: Ignoring accessibility until the end of the project
pitfall.why_problematic: Accessibility fixes become expensive and may require significant redesign
pitfall.correct_approach: Include accessibility considerations in every design and development decision

pitfall.why_problematic: Makes components hard to use and maintain
pitfall.correct_approach: Start simple, add complexity only when needed, favor composition over configuration

category.name: before_starting
category.item: Understand target users and accessibility requirements
Review existing design patterns and brand guidelines
Check current Tailwind configuration and build setup
Identify device and browser support requirements

category.name: during_implementation
category.item: Validate color contrast ratios for all text
Test keyboard navigation for all interactive elements
Follow consistent spacing and typography patterns
Use semantic HTML and proper ARIA attributes

category.name: before_completion
category.item: Test across target devices and browsers
Run accessibility audit with automated tools
Verify performance impact on bundle size
Review code for consistency with design system
